title: Dual-Device iPhone (Personal + Corporate iOS) Management with Single Sign-On in Microsoft Intune
author_notes: The solution must allow a single user account to sign in on both the COD and BYOD device for scenarios where a user has 2 devices, a Personal and Corporate Owned device.

Forked (+1) from cod-byod-dual-device-sso v1.0.0: an iOS-iPhone-specific variant — corporate iPhone via Apple Business Manager + Automated Device Enrollment (supervised), personal iPhone via App Protection (MAM) / Account-Driven User Enrollment, single sign-on across both via the Microsoft Authenticator broker + iOS Enterprise SSO extension. Source products are unchanged.
